body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Reduce the target's next incoming Damage by 1 and next forced movement by 1 unit until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The target gains +1 Fortitude against hazards until the start of your next turn.
You and the ally both receive the protection.

rider.title: Adaptation - Bulwark
rider.html: Assume Mantle (upkeep 1): the first Damage you take each round is reduced by 1. This is prevention, not increased Resilience or removal of accumulated Damage.
